allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Android Studio ==="; $paths = @\("$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\Android Studio", "C:\\Program Files\\Android\\Android Studio"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { Write-Output "FOUND: $p" } else { Write-Output "not found: $p" } }; Write-Output "=== SDK ==="; if \(Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk"\) { Write-Output "SDK FOUND: $env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk"; Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name } else { Write-Output "SDK not found at $env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Android\\Sdk" }; Write-Output "=== env vars ==="; Write-Output "ANDROID_HOME=$env:ANDROID_HOME"; Write-Output "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"; Write-Output "JAVA_HOME=$env:JAVA_HOME")
Bash(cmd //c "echo JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME% & echo ANDROID_HOME=%ANDROID_HOME% & echo ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=%ANDROID_SDK_ROOT%")
